role: Assistant Division Administrator, FHWA Illinois Division
stance_basis: signed administrative letter notifying of substitution of Negative Declaration for draft EIS and explaining reasons
summary: Manuel A. Marks, as Assistant Division Administrator for the FHWA Illinois Division, signed two letters dated December 30, 1975: one to the Illinois Department of Transportation notifying them of the substitution of a Negative Declaration for the draft EIS, and one to the Council on Environmental Quality explaining the reasons for that substitution. His role is administrative and procedural, conveying official FHWA determinations rather than expressing personal support or opposition to the project.
complaint_summary: Marks notifies the Illinois DOT Director that a Negative Declaration has been substituted for the draft EIS and instructs them to notify all agencies and individuals who commented on or requested the draft EIS, while noting that a Section 4(f) Statement will still be needed for Cook County Forest Preserve lands.

statement.text:
Dear Mr. Kramer:
Subject: Draft Environmental Impact Statement
Illinois Project F-239( )
FAP-23, US-30 (Lincoln Highway) Cicero Avenue to Chicago Road
Cook County
FHWA-ILL-EIS-72-16-D
Enclosed for your information is a copy of our letter of December 30, 1975 to the Council on Environmental Quality advising that we have substituted a Negative Declaration for the subject draft EIS.
As soon as possible you should notify all agencies and individuals who commented on the draft EIS, or who requested a copy of the final EIS, that the substitution has been made. A copy of our letter to the Council on Environmental Quality may be used as an enclosure with your letter if you so desire.
Please note that the substitution does not affect the need for approval of use of Section 4(f) lands. A Section 4(f) Statement will be needed so that we can request approval of use of lands owned by the Cook County Forest Preserve District.
Sincerely yours,
Marrark
Manuel A. Marks
Assistant Division Administrator
For: Jay W. Miller Division Administrator
Enclosure
